messages:
alex: Heads up - release window 04:00 UTC. Deploy-bot queued runtime r3.11.2 and console c2.2.0 but router is still at rtr-4.0.0-alpha. Console has new websocket reconnect logic that expects router to set upgrade timeout header.
maria: We flagged router as alpha in config, didn't realize it was still present in the pool. That mismatch could cause sticky session timeouts.
deploy-bot: scheduled: 2026-05-01 04:00 UTC. Components: api=stable, runtime=r3.11.2, console=c2.2.0. Canary plan: 3% -> 15% -> 100%. Rollback runtime: /deploy rollback runtime r3.11.1.
console-eng: In canary staging, 1.5% of websocket connects failed with 408 due to missing "x-rwd-upgrade-timeout". Router alpha doesn't emit it.
sre-ops: Suggest gating websocket feature in console or add router shim. Product approval needed for pin/unpin.
alex: Product is oncall but might be asleep. Can we run console with websocket fallback disabled for first canary wave?
console-eng: We can. Add query param ?ws_fallback=legacy to enable fallback for console builds. Will ship flag today.
maria: Alternatively, could we move a small fraction of router instances back to stable 3.9.x for the window? That needs infra coordination and might be heavier.
sre-ops: We've got muscle to flip a few router instances but it's higher risk. Prefer feature-flag in console for minimal blast radius.
deploy-bot: plan updated: console=c2.2.0 canary 3% with ws_fallback=legacy enabled. Runtime r3.11.2 runs as-is. Canary auto-scales to 15% after manual ack. Abort: >1% increase in websocket 408s for 10 mins.
econsole: (bot) Telemetry event rwd.ws.upgrade_error will be emitted when upgrade fails.
console-eng: We'll also add a dashboard for rwd.ws.upgrade_error and a runbook action: if spike > threshold, call /deploy rollback console c2.2.0.
alex: Good. Preflight at 03:15 UTC. I'll be on call for window. Also check sticky cookie behavior for router alpha.
sre-ops: Router alpha instances identified and removed from canary pool. Will reconcile by 03:00 UTC.
deploy-bot: reminder scheduled. Preflight checklist: ws_fallback flag set, dashboard created, router alpha removed from canary, rollback runbook noted.
maria: tagging @product informally. If they want to unpin router or approve a full rollout, we'll coordinate a follow-up release.
econsole: (bot) Note: console c2.2.0 includes telemetry tag console.release=c2.2.0 for easier slicing.
